description: Sets up Page Scanner's helper, which Chrome starts to connect the extension to this server, in every Chromium browser on this computer. Needs no port and no token, and returns no secret. Only needed once per machine. Afterwards the user opens the Page Scanner settings in Chrome, Local Agents, presses Connect and allows the prompt; tell them that, since you cannot do it for them.

extensionIds.description: More extension ids to allow by hand. Leave out: the Chrome Web Store build and any unpacked copy of Page Scanner loaded in developer mode are allowed without it.

name: install
title: Set up Page Scanner on this computer
